To draw the projections of points on a common reference line ($XY$) with projectors $30\text{ mm}$ apart:

- **Point A:** In the H.P. means its Top View ($a$) lies on $XY$. $45\text{ mm}$ behind the V.P. means its Front View ($a'$) is $45\text{ mm}$ above $XY$.
- **Point B:** $35\text{ mm}$ in front of the V.P. means its Top View ($b$) is $35\text{ mm}$ below $XY$. In the H.P. means its Front View ($b'$%) lies on $XY$.
- **Point C:** $56\text{ mm}$ above the H.P. means its Front View ($c'$) is $56\text{ mm}$ above $XY$. $37\text{ mm}$ behind the V.P. means its Top View ($c$) is $37\text{ mm}$ above $XY$.

```text
        c' (56 above)
        |                  a' (45 above)
        c (37 above)       |
--+--------------------+--------------------+---- XY Line
  |                    a (on XY)            |
  b' (on XY)                                |
  |                                         |
  b (35 below)                              |
<-------- 30 mm -------><------- 30 mm ------->
```
proTip: Always mark the top views with lowercase letters without primes and front views with lowercase letters with primes.
